description: WebSocket pushes streamed text_delta events (seq 5,6), the client renders them and advances its cursor, then a follow-up HTTP delta with afterSeq=6 returns nothing new. Pins cross-channel dedup via the shared latestSeq cursor plus the WS providerEventId dedup set.
note: Contract-shaped fixture, not a byte-exact server capture. text_delta is transient: it is pushed live over WS but never persisted, so the HTTP persistent set never contains it. The cursor advance after WS render is what makes the subsequent HTTP delta empty.

afterWsRender.wsDedupSetNote: filterRealtimeSessionEvents keys text_delta by 'text_delta:{providerEventId}' in seenRealtimeEventIds (LRU cap 8192), cleared on session switch.

httpDeltaAfterWs.comment: Cursor is already at 6 (WS render advanced it), and there are no persisted events with seq > 6, so the delta is empty. No cross-channel duplication.

replaySuppression.comment: If the same text_delta (providerEventId td_0001) is pushed again over WS — e.g. a replay after a brief reconnect — filterRealtimeSessionEvents drops it because 'text_delta:td_0001' is already in seenRealtimeEventIds. The client never double-renders it.
